about: Mabel's annotations, an invented case. Every participant turn in order, found by its opening words: its experiential statements, its exploratory note, its key quotes as said and the words highlighted, or empty for a turn reviewed and left empty. Then the times of the work and her PET board. make_demo.py builds the workbook, the progress file and the themes file from this and the interview CSV beside it.

turns.at: Well. It's noisy, for a start.
es: A dog like having the lights on
A house where everything stayed put
turns.en: Her image is light, not noise, though the noise comes first as a joke. Before, a cup still there in the morning.
kq: It's like having the lights on.
turns.crux: It's like having the lights on.

turns.at: No. And I'm a tidy person, or I was.
es: A tidy person glad of disorder
Things staying put, nothing happening
Signs that somebody has been living here
turns.en: Two years of stillness, named plainly. The glasses case in the dog's bed counts as evidence of life.
kq: a house where things stay put is a house where nothing's happening

turns.at: She gets me up at seven.
es: Got up at seven by a polite stare
Lying in till nine, nothing to get up for
Waterproof trousers for the first time
turns.en: The days before had no start. A polite insistence, felt through the eyelids. New clothes for a new routine.
kq: there wasn't anything to get up for

es: A morning society seen only with a dog
Twenty years on the estate, knowing nobody
The dogs' names first, then the people's
turns.en: A world there all along, opened to her with the dog. She knows its etiquette and explains it.
kq: You wouldn't know it unless you had a dog.

turns.at: It's lovely. I don't want to overdo it
es: Losing the habit of people
Talk happening round the edges
Walking Terry's greyhounds for a fortnight
turns.en: No effort asked of her, the dog is the reason to be there. Help given as well as taken.
kq: the talking just happens round the edges
turns.crux: the talking just happens round the edges

es: Toast standing up, most nights
Saying she was fine and not being
Eating again with someone depending on her
turns.en: She plays down her own word, saved. Feeding the dog and feeding herself go together in her telling.
kq: you can't feed a dog and not feed yourself, it looks ridiculous

es: Six months of thinking it a mistake
Pulled flat on the ice
turns.en: Doubt at the start, told with humour. The fall comes quickly, almost comic.
kq: Flat on my face. Broke my wrist.

es: Being told the dog had to go
The one proper row in years
Treated like a child with a puppy
turns.en: She grants her daughter's care and still feels something taken from her.
kq: it felt like she was taking something off me

es: Feeling small, and frightened too
What if it had been her hip
Knowing by morning she would keep her
turns.en: The night in the sling, two fears side by side. The decision is there by morning, without argument.
kq: What happens to her then. What happens to me.

es: Training classes at seventy three
Standing like a lamppost until she comes back
turns.en: At my age: pride as much as surprise. Patience as her answer to the fall.
kq: Just stop dead and stand there like a lamppost until she comes back.

turns.at: Better. She came to watch a class
es: A brief all right, nothing more said
A chew for Pepper as the sign
turns.en: Mending without talking about it. She finds it in the chew.
kq: But she brings Pepper a chew when she comes now. That's how I know.

turns.at: All the time. Not in a gloomy way.
es: Doing the sums on who goes first
Pepper likely to outlive her
A home for Pepper written into the will
turns.en: The losing turned round: her own death and the dog's future. Responsible, she says, not morbid.

turns.at: Strange. Sitting in the solicitor's office
es: Pepper's name beside the house and the watch
Lighter, like putting something down
The picture of her waiting at the door
turns.en: The will sets the dog among Dennis's things and the house. Relief in the body, on the wall outside.
kq: Her waiting by the door for me.

turns.at: Yes. Because she does, you see.
es: At the window every time she returns
Little thought of her own end
The dog all right after she has gone
turns.en: Waiting is the image that carries it. Her own death matters here as the dog's loss.
kq: I couldn't bear the thought of her doing that and me never coming.

es: Telling the dog what she told Dennis
Forty years of telling someone her day
Catching herself on the price of butter
turns.en: The habit of a marriage finds a listener. She laughs at herself and keeps on.
kq: It had nowhere to go. Now it goes to her.

es: On the bed now, on his side
Breathing in the night again
turns.en: She closes the subject herself, I'll say that and leave it there. The side of the bed is his.
kq: It's nice to hear breathing in the night again.

turns.at: Only that I didn't expect it.
es: Not expecting any of it
Fitter at seventy three than at sixty
Shut in until the dog opened the door
turns.en: Her own summary, sleet and all. Glad, said twice.
kq: I was shut in and she opened the door.
